This Writ Petition Is Filed Under Articles 226
And 227 Of The Constitution Of India, Praying To
Direct The Respondents To Pay Compensation At The
Rate Of Rs.20,00,000/ Per Year From The Year 2018 Till
The Land To An Extent Of 4 Acres 30 Cents Bearing Sy
No.210/2 Os Sarapady Village, Bantral Taluk D.K.
District Is Restored To The Petitioner In Its Original
Condition For The Forcible Acquisition/
Dispossession Of The Petitioner From Th Said Land
And Direct The Respondents To Restore The
Possession Of The Said Land To The Petitioner By
Removing All The Encroachments And Further
Restrain Respondents From Entering Into The Said
Land Except By Following The Due Process Of Law As
Provided Under Right To Fair Compensation And
Transparency In Land Acquisition Rehabilitation And
Resettlement Act 2013, Etc.

This Petition, Coming On For Orders, This Day,
The Court Made The Following:
 Order

1. It is the case of the petitioner that the compensation offered vide Annexure-F in a sum of Rs.59,31,348/- is NC: 2024:KHC:9991 unacceptable and he has also submitted a representation in that regard.

sentences.text: 2. In view of the fact that the petitioner is not prepared to get the compensation determined by way of an agreement, necessarily the Land Acquisition Officer would have to pass an Award in accordance with law and if the petitioner is aggrieved by passing of such an Award, it is open for him to seek for a reference to Civil Court.
3. Writ Petition is accordingly disposed of.
4. The Special Land Acquisition Officer shall pass an Award within a period of three months from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
